What you'll be doing:
The Risk and Governance Analyst plays a key role in supporting the organisation’s risk governance and policy framework. The role focuses on maintaining and enhancing the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF), risk policies, and systems of governance to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal requirements. This position will oversee policy attestation processes, support governance reporting, and administer the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system. Working closely with the Head of Risk Reporting and Analysis, the role will contribute to strengthening risk culture, ensuring transparency, and embedding robust governance practices across the organisation.
• Maintain and update the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and associated risk policies.
• Coordinate policy attestation processes and ensure compliance with governance standards.
• Support the development and continuous improvement of systems of governance in line with regulatory expectations (e.g., FCA, TPR).
• Administer and maintain the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system, ensuring accurate data capture and reporting.
• Act as a key point of contact for queries related to governance and risk systems functionality.
• Support integration of governance data with risk and compliance MI.
